national_law.name: National Cybersecurity Bill
national_law.formal_citation: General Scheme for the National Cybersecurity Bill
national_law.status_note: Pre-legislative scrutiny phase. Joint Oireachtas Committee on Justice reviewing. Expected approval early-to-mid 2026. Delayed by 2024 elections.

preparatory_measures: NCSC released draft risk management measures

infringement_proceedings.status: Active - potential CJEU referral if not resolved

sources.title: William Fry - NIS2 Ireland and Draft Guidance

notes: Ireland has NOT yet transposed NIS2 as of March 2026
